title: A constructible sheaf of modules on the spectrum of a field becomes constant over a finite separable extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $G$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $(\operatorname{Spec}k)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod((\operatorname{Spec}k)_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are a finite separable field extension $K/k$, a finite $\Lambda$-module $M$ (finite as a set) and an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $\pi^{-1}G\cong\underline M$ on $(\operatorname{Spec}K)_{\Et}$, where $\pi:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is the induced morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $\pi^{-1}$ the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $\underline M$ the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. (Expected proof, for the split: a stratification of the one-point space $\operatorname{Spec}k$ has exactly one nonempty stratum, whose immersion is an isomorphism onto $\operatorname{Spec}k$, so $G$ is finite locally constant: there are an etale covering $\{U_i\to\operatorname{Spec}k\}$ and finite $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$ with $G|_{U_i}\cong\underline{M_i}$; some $U_i$ is nonempty; an etale $k$-scheme is a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable extensions of $k$ (Stacks 02GL), so some $\operatorname{Spec}K\to U_i$ is an open and closed immersion with $K/k$ finite separable; the inverse image of a constant sheaf is constant.)
